title: Whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy for DCIS
population: 818 women with localized DCIS and histologically tumor-free margins
summary: Adding 50 Gy whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy reduced 8-year invasive ipsilateral breast recurrence from 13.4% to 3.9%, an absolute reduction of 9.5 percentage points.
criticalReview: NSABP B-17 established the local-control benefit of whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy for DCIS. Because B-17 is already a permanent trial page in the master roster, it does not need to be added again as a new trial or archive-only entry.
